annotations.title: Calculate or audit a distribution waterfall between investors and sponsor

description: Waterfall and distribution calculator and audit for syndications and small funds. Send the terms (preferred return percent, simple or compound, carry percent, optional catch-up percent), the capital contributed (date, amount) and the cash distributed (date, amount). Get back, per distribution, the split between investors and sponsor tier by tier, with balances left. Add claimed_investors and claimed_sponsor to a distribution to audit a spreadsheet or administrator's figures: you get match or differ to the cent, whether the claim adds up to the cash, and which other reading of the terms (day count 360 or 365, compounding, no preferred return, catch-up on or off) would reproduce it. Answer fields: verdict, summary, distributions (in your order, each with index, tiers, to_investors, to_sponsor, audit), reproduced_by, sources, rule, observation, signature; all money is text. Errors: ok false with a message (400 bad input, 413 too large, 429 hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, no request contents stored, signed record. Up to 100 contributions and 100 distributions. Use your own labels, not names or account numbers. Not legal, tax, investment or accounting advice; your fund documents decide.

amount.description: At most 2 decimals; text ("1250.50") keeps it exact.

claimed_investors.description: To audit: the amount a spreadsheet or administrator says went to the investors (send both claimed fields).

claimed_sponsor.description: To audit: the amount it says went to the sponsor.

fund_label.description: Your own label for the deal (not a person).

carry_percent.description: Sponsor's share of profit above the preferred return, 0 to 50 (default 20).

catch_up_percent.description: 0 = no catch-up (default). Otherwise the share of the catch-up tier that goes to the sponsor (e.g. 100 or 50); must be above carry_percent. The tier ends when the sponsor holds carry_percent of all profit paid so far.

day_basis.description: Days in a year for the preferred return (default 365; actual days elapsed).

pref_compounding.description: simple: preferred return on unreturned capital only (default). compound: unpaid preferred return also earns it, so investors reach exactly that annual rate of return before the sponsor shares.

pref_rate_percent.description: Annual preferred return in percent, 0 to 100, at most 2 decimals, e.g. 8.

tolerance.description: Largest difference in money that still counts as a match, 0 to 1 (default 0.01).
